dollar_decline.description: Structural shifts in global currency hegemony and the weaponization of trade settlements.

energy_sovereignty.description: Geopolitical strategy surrounding natural resources and the independence of national energy grids.

deglobalization.description: The retreat from integrated global markets toward regionalized supply chains and protectionist policy.

china_ascent.description: Strategic evaluation of China's economic and industrial trajectory against Western incumbents.

space_economy.description: Commercialization of low-earth orbit and the strategic militarization of the space domain.

gene_editing.description: The maturation of CRISPR technologies and the reshaping of the bio-pharmaceutical industry.

tech_convergence.description: The fusion of AI, cloud infrastructure, and legacy software into unified enterprise intelligence stacks.

wealthy_sports.description: The financialization of elite sports franchises as private equity, hedge funds, and sovereign wealth vehicles.

ai_chips.description: The escalating race for compute dominance and the silicon supply chain as a cornerstone of national security.

crypto_reserve.description: The integration of digital assets into institutional balance sheets and their role as non-sovereign macro hedges.

rate_cycle.description: Central bank policy pivots, yield curve dynamics, and the interplay between liquidity and inflationary risk.

commodity_supercycle.description: Structural imbalances in raw material supply, fueled by energy transitions and long-term under-investment.
